name: deps_read

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

item.description: Item id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters.

direction.description: incoming = edges whose to is item (what blocks it), outgoing = edges whose from is item. Default all. [select: list]

type.description: Only edges of this type. Default both. [select: list]

cursor.description: The page.next value of the previous page.

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Read dependency edges between items. select: list (edges of one item, with direction and type filters) or graph (the blocking graph around an item). Edge: {id, from, to, type, unblockAt?}; from blocks to. Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
